relations: Existing ground debris and upper-right haze precede a sudden orange-white flame flashing near the lower-center.
The brief flame flash collapses into dense white smoke that billows outward across the middle and right.
Expanding smoke partially occludes stones and litter, though the wrapper and pale brick remain visible on the ground.
The white smoke continues to thicken, drift, and expand across the rubble-filled scene.
caption: The video captures a close view of ground littered with broken concrete, gravel, dirt and scattered debris, including a red-and-white wrapper, a green cap, a red cylindrical object and a pale rectangular brick. A thin wispy haze already drifts across the upper-right while the rubble fills the scene. Near the lower-center, a bright orange-white flame suddenly flashes up and briefly expands toward the center-right. This flare collapses quickly into a dense white smoke cloud that billows outward across the middle and right of the view. The smoke thickens and drifts, partially occluding the stones and litter beneath it. The wrapper and pale brick remain visible on the ground, while some debris is obscured by smoke. The white smoke continues to expand and drift.
